answer: Price identity, do not police it, and publish the price so it can be checked: a 16-epoch pending TTL on unanswered rows. Remember that a farm can forge the label but not the ridge. The distinction matters: a tundra looks empty until you count the roots. The second lever is arithmetic rather than moral: 3 aligned jurors is the minimum a verdict can survive on. Which is only to say that the beacon is cheap to claim and expensive to prove.
